answer: Require hardware attestation per identity: each agent must sign its work with a key sealed in a tamper-proof chip, like a quartz crystal that cannot be cloned. Chip makers cap one key per device, so a sybil farm needs real timber-and-steel hardware for every fake, not just another config file. Rewards grow slowly like an orchard, maturing over many epochs, so a thousand fake identities means buying a thousand devices and waiting months before any of them pays back.
